lines.english: "Huh, Kitahara-san?"
"Ah…"
I thought the bicycle passing by me stopped to make way for me, yet its rider spoke with a voice I recognized.
"What's the matter? Do you have business at our place?"
"What about you, Takahiro-kun? Are you going out this late?"
Yet I wouldn't call the meeting miraculous, just a small coincidence.
…After all, I'm only 200 meters away from the Ogiso household.
"About that, I received two tickets for a late screening. It's the film I promised to watch with a friend, and apparently the director is even meeting with the audience too."
"Ooh, you got them for free?"
"Yeah, mom got them for me. She knows a guy who owns stock in the theater."
"I see…"
And the reason for Takahiro-kun being out at this time is neither a coincidence nor a miracle.
He was lured away.
"Nee-chan isn't home right now, you know? Yanagihara-san came about an hour ago and left with her."
"Oh, I see…"
So they even lured away Setsuna…
"That's strange. Did you two promise to meet today?"
"No… not really. I'm not going to your place today. I have some business to take care of somewhere else around here."
"Hmm?"
Is he trying to be considerate… or did his mother tell him to?
"Ah, by the way… since you're here, I might as well ask."
"Hm? What is it?"
"Have you and Nee-chan been fighting?"
"…What gave you that impression?"
It was a very predictable question.
"Because she's been weird lately. As soon as she comes back from work, she just locks herself in her room. She always eats out and never shows her face around the living room anymore."
And the way Takahiro described Setsuna's current condition was also something that I'd anticipated.
"Just two days ago, when I saw her in the corridor, she immediately went back to her room, almost as if she was running away from me."
As is the fact that Takahiro-kun has noticed by now that something is wrong with her.
"And when I got angry and knocked on her door, I heard her turning the lock on it."
"…I see, you do know something about it. You wouldn't be going so quiet otherwise."
"…I'm no match for you, am I?"
Truly, I am no match for the Ogiso family, and their love for each other.
Everyone's always concerned for each other, and even the slightest change in behavior catches their attention. And they don't hesitate to try helping each other.
Something that never existed in the Kitahara family, and something that was completely one-sided in the Touma family. That kind of heartwarming love.
"What are you doing, Kitahara-san? The two of you just got engaged."
"…You're right."
I was supposed to become a part of this family before long.
That shining jewel on Setsuna's finger was supposed to light up my way to a brighter future.
"Make up soon, okay? I can't bear how things are at home anymore."
"…Sorry."
But I'm sorry. I'm really sorry.
"You don't have to apologize, you know. Let your actions speak for themselves…"
"Ah… sorry. I have to go now!"
But there is absolutely nothing I can do, other than apologize…
"Oh, okay… see you."
"Right… have fun."
Takahiro is out, and Setsuna is away.
The only people waiting for me at the Ogiso household are those two.
In other words, this is something they don't want their children to see… and a conversation they don't want them to hear.
"…Hey, Tomo."
"Hm?"
"Why have you been so quiet since we came here?"
"Quiet…?"
"You come and force me out of my home, and then all you do is drink tea."
"I didn't have anything else to do."
"That can't be true. Every time you have time on your hands, you either go to the beauty salon or go training."
"…On some weekends I prefer doing nothing."
"It's me, isn't it? You're worried about me because of last week?"
"…I have no idea what you're talking about."
"Sorry about back then… I behaved really inappropriately."
"There's no reason to apologize. After all, I'm on your side, and I'm your friend…"
"Thank you… but I'm fine now. I've decided to keep doing my best."
"It might be a bit unreasonable for me to ask this, considering what I did, but I want you to forget all about last week."
"Forget…?"
"You just said you had no idea what I was talking about, right? So it shouldn't be difficult for you."
"I wasn't crying back then. In fact, I had absolutely no reason to cry in the first place."
"Setsuna…?"
"True, we ran into some obstacles, but we've had plenty of those before… and we've always overcome them."
"Does that mean…"
"So I'll continue doing my best! I'll give it everything I have! That's the way our relationship has been from the start… so it'll be fine this time too!"
"…Setsuna, stop it! Don't force yourself to act strong…"
"I'm not forcing myself. After all, the person who taught me that everyone will be rewarded if they keep their hearts strong is none other than…"
"Don't push yourself so much… It's okay to cry… You have every right to be hurt right now, Setsuna."
"…What are you saying?"
"It's okay to show your weak side sometimes. To us, and even to him."
"You're wrong… I can't rely on anyone else. This is a problem with my feelings. If only I can manage to keep a strong heart, everything will be solved…"
"What you should be doing right now is clinging to Kitahara-san!"
"You've got it wrong."
"Stop worrying about appearances. Don't try to act like you're okay! Don't blame yourself! Don't keep everything to yourself!"
"Like I said, you've got it wrong…"
"Let your feelings come out! Tell him not to go, tell him to not leave you behind! Tell that to him, and let everyone know!"
"If you do that, I'm sure he'll come back to you. As long as he realizes how much he's hurting you, he'll… After all, he's always had a strong sense of responsibility."
"We'll help you too… I promise we'll sway Kitahara-san's feelings…"
"…You don't have to do anything unnecessary."
"This is a matter between the three of us. It has nothing to do with you."
"Nothing to do with us, how could…"
"…Sorry, perhaps that came out a bit strong. But you really don't have to do anything."
"I don't particularly mind, but isn't that a bit unfair to Mizusawa-san and Iizuka-san? How many times do you think they've helped you out?"
"I know, and I love them… but I'll have to insist, this one time."
"…Why?"
"Because everyone will start blaming Haruki-kun. They'll say he's in the wrong or something stupid like that."
"…Do you mean that what he said to you was so cruel that we couldn't possibly understand?"
"…! It's because you say things like that that I don't want to talk about it…"
"So that's why you don't want us to intervene. It's because you know the fault is all on Kitahara-san's side…"
"Haruki-kun is not in the wrong!"
"We merely hit a snag. If only we can talk it out, he'll understand."
"Setsuna…"
"So please, don't say a word to Haruki-kun. I'll talk to him myself, and I'll take as much time as I need…"
"I know more about him than anyone. Please, leave us be for now."
"Setsuna…!"
"I'll come up with something. So please, don't back him into a corner."
"It's too late for that…"
"I apologize for calling you here on your day off."
"No, it's… it's no trouble."
By the time I entered the living room, the mood was already painfully heavy.
Maybe it is because of the weight I carry with me here, or perhaps it's caused by Setsuna's parents at the thought of speaking to me.
It probably is because of both.
"Under normal circumstances, we wouldn't have to speak to you about this directly… Especially at a time when Setsuna is not around, which I'm aware is not commendable."
"No, I don't really mind."
"However, we have been very concerned about Setsuna, and we don't consider you to be an outsider to our family, Kitahara-kun… Though if you disagree with that assumption, you may correct me."
"I don't disagree. I'm glad that you think so."
Hearing that was supposed to be something happy.
I've visited the Ogiso family more times than I can count, and Setsuna's mother and Takahiro-kun have long since considered me as part of the family.
Yet today is the first time I'm hearing her father suggest such a thing.
"Let's get into the matter at hand."
"Yes…"
And now, I cannot even feel the slightest happiness over being accepted as someone close to the family.
"Let me first confirm, Kitahara-kun, do you have any idea on why we called you here today?"
"I do…"
Setsuna's father and I face one another, while her mother looks at us from the side, clearly restless, and shuffling between looking at us and looking away.
Almost like a completely different person from the woman who would gossip to me about Setsuna's complaints and fondness toward me, only to get glared at by Setsuna for it.
Tension, uncertainty, worry and fear mix together in her eyes. Those eyes tell me she is praying.
"At the beginning of this month… the last time you were here, you talked to us about your future together with Setsuna, with many implications."
"D-Darling, that… was just something Takahiro and I decided was the case on our own. And it was something we thought would only happen quite far in the future…"
And most likely… I'm looking back at them with the same look on my face as hers.
"If that's the case he can set the record straight now. That he never made such a promise, that he never spoke to Setsuna about their future together."
"No…"
I put my hands on my lap and close them tightly. There's enough sweat in my clenched fists to spill out between my fingers.
I can tell exactly how this is going to play out.
"A short while before that, I gave Setsuna… your daughter, a ring. We also spoke of our future."
A chain of events that I never desired, but one that I can't avoid.
"And would I be correct to assume that your intention was… to marry her?"
"Yes… at the time."
"At the time, huh…"
The two of them may have thought that those words were a slip of the tongue.
"And what exactly does that mean? Are we correct to assume your intentions are still the same as back then?"
However, it was planned from the start. A means to guide the conversation in the right direction.
"Would we be correct to assume that you desire to spend the future with Setsuna… our daughter?"
"About that…"
It's a direction that I do not want to head in, yet one I cannot avoid.
No matter how many times I think of getting away from it, I always end up back here again. So I want to at least avoid prolonging the pain.
Not just for myself, but for Setsuna's parents too…
"I'm sorry… circumstances have changed since then."
"…! Kitahara-san!"
"I cannot marry Setsuna… your daughter. Please allow me to take back my proposal."
"Ah, aah… Aaah…!"
Please, let this be over with already. I acknowledge all my wrongdoings, so hurry up and give me my judgement.
I'll accept any punishment. So please, quickly… acknowledge my error…
"What… did you say…?"
"They should be talking about it right about now… him and your parents."
"The reason I took you here today is because your mom… asked me to. She told me that they wanted to talk to Kitahara-san without you."
"Why…? Why would they…?"
"Because they probably knew. They knew that you'd definitely protect Kitahara-san if you were around."
"That wasn't my question! Why do mom and dad… Tomo, did you tell them!?"
"Your mom was the one who let us know… they noticed that something was wrong with the way you were acting since quite some time ago."
"That's why I met up with Kitahara-san yesterday to get the truth… with the help of Iizuka-san and Mizusawa-san."
"Even… Io… and Takeya-kun?"
"Everyone knows already! All the horrible things Kitahara-san said to you… all the horrible things he did…"
"This isn't something you can sort out on your own anymore, Setsuna. You'll just end up forgiving him. You won't be able to make him regret what he's done."
"Regret…? There is no reason for that. All I have to do is to find a way for the three of us to be together… If only I can find a better solution…"
"That won't make Kitahara-san come back to you! He's going to Europe with Touma Kazusa!"
"…! Stop it! Stop it, stop it, stop it!"
"Setsuna!"
"Why is everyone so set on backing Haruki-kun into a corner? Why are you all so quick to jump to conclusions!?"
"That's because… what he's saying right now is utterly absurd! What he's done to you is beyond cruel!"
"It's not over yet… It's not at all over between us yet! So why are people trying to end it when it's none of their business!?"
"…! None… of our business?"
"Stop it, stop it already… Stop acting against Haruki-kun… Stop getting mad over your own misunderstandings… Stop deciding that it's all over…!"
"How… how can you… say that?"
"…I'm going home! This should cover the bill."
"I was, I was just… worried about you and…!"
"Don't call me from now on, because I won't answer!"
"Ah… uh, uah… I do feel… bad about it but…"
"But, but… You don't have to… say it like that…!"
"…! Uaa… aa-aah…!"
Setsuna's dad is looking at me with a stern look.
And her mom can't stop crying.
They're both deeply affected by my selfish words, coming from their daughter's "ex-boyfriend."
Which means… that they don't see me as "just her boyfriend."
A reminder that they saw me as someone special to the family.
"…May I ask why?"
"I'm in love… with a different woman."
"…! That can't be."
Which is why my words also have a weight heavier than the words of an ex-boyfriend, a weight heavy enough to crush their hearts.

I can imagine the emotions that are violently boiling within them right now; they must be furious and grief-stricken at how I ended up ruining their daughter, who they raised with utmost love and care…
…And I imagine they're also carrying an immeasurably deep hatred toward me.
"Surely, that has to be a lie, right? That can't be what you told Setsuna…"
"Mother…"
Even so, they still try to assume the best of me.
"There is another reason for this, right? She can be really inconsiderate sometimes, maybe it's that…?"
"That's not it… at all, not even a little bit."
"Did you have a disagreement over who to invite to the wedding? Or you couldn't agree on whether you should continue with your current job after the marriage…?"
"Like I said, that's not it."
"If it has anything to do with what we have said, then you don't have to worry about it! The most important thing is what you two want together… so, please?"
"That's not it. It really… is just a change of heart on my side alone. Setsuna has not done anything wrong."
"…!? T-That… can't be…!"
That unwarranted trust…
And the pain I feel as I watch it all collapse without leaving a trace.
"I thought you…"
And then…
"I thought you to be a man who just wouldn't ever say something like that of all things."
"Father…"
Without time to tend to my wounds, the next sharp needle pierces my chest.
"Due to circumstances, we might not have had the best impression on one another. I admit I avoided you, and you may have wanted to keep me at arm's length."
"That was… not the case."
"But the reason I acted that way was because Setsuna trusted and loved you completely… and I felt like it was out of my hands."
He's controlling his emotions and speaks calmly…
However, his calmness does not suggest a lack of emotion from my betrayal at all.
"I thought of telling her, 'He might just be tricking you' or 'See what happened last time?'…"
"But those weren't words I could tell my daughter… because I thought that you loved Setsuna from the bottom of your heart. I thought you were a man I could trust…!"
"…! …I'm so sorry!"
I raise my voice without realizing it.
I have almost no memories left of being scolded by my father. Yet I can feel that the might in this man's voice has that same sternness.
I had even dreamed about the day I could call him my father, where he would give me a light scolding over a pint of beer.
Yet, the words he speaks to me now are neither kind nor are they affectionately trying to lecture me.
It was a powerful and stern voice that was defending a man's "family" from an "enemy."
"I'm so sorry… I apologize!"
Seeing that his words made me shrink, he lets out a sorrowful sigh.
I couldn't even come up with an excuse, much less contradict him.
In the end, I could never tell him "I'm not wrong."
"Well then… what are you going to do now?"
"I'll speak to Setsuna one more time. I won't ask her to understand, but I hope I can at least convince her to forget me."
"However, you're in this city. You live and work here… You could still pass each other by on the train or on the streets."
"That won't…"
"Do you not think it is unfair to ask that of her? To forget about you despite you being so close to her…?"
"…Please don't worry. I don't think we'll ever see each other again."
"How do you intend on convincing us of that?"
"I'll be leaving this city soon. From April, I'll be living abroad."
"Abroad… is it a part of a job transfer?"
"U-Um! Maybe that's the reason you're breaking up with Setsuna…? You don't want to keep her waiting by herself when you're out and…"
"You've got it wrong, Mother."
Setsuna's mother is desperately trying to find a proper explanation that puts me in a positive light, up until the very end.
And as a result, the sins I have committed only become more vivid in my mind…
"That's where… she lives."
"I'm going to… Vienna. I'm sorry for all the trouble I've caused you."
"Ah… Aah!?"
She finally realized it.
She's realized who my partner is.
She's realized that it's "the friend Setsuna once brought home from school five years ago."
"…Is everything settled now? Or is there anything else?"
I'm trying to run away right now.
The way I tried to avoid any further questions was an utterly despicable attempt to end the conversation.
"If there is nothing else to talk about, I'll be…"
Even so, I have no other choice right now.
I didn't have the strength to bring up her name here.
I stand up and bow to the two parents who are still stiff as two rocks, and open the living room door…
Right in front of the door… I bump into someone in the corridor.
And Setsuna's mother, who realized who that someone was, opened her tear-filled red eyes in horror.
In other words, I wasn't the only one who didn't expect this.
"Were you… listening?"
His shoulders were shaking.
His head was hanging in the darkness, so his face was hidden. Yet both of his hands were clenched in anger, and his whole body looked petrified.
"I'm sorry…"
That alone was enough for me to tell how long he had been listening for. And his feelings came through to me almost painfully…
"Sorry, Takahiro-kun… I…"
"Huaaah!"
And those clenched fists flew into the air.
I calmly closed my eyes.
"Takahiro!?"
"What the hell was that all about!? What the hell are you even saying!? Have you gone completely insane!?"
I feel a heavy impact on the back of my head, and a pain that spreads from my cheeks to my mouth.
A warm metallic taste spreads to the depths of my nose and my throat.
"I'm sorry… I'm sorry."
"Shut your mouth!"
"Nee-chan, Nee-chan… What are you going to do about Nee-chan!?"
"Weren't you together ever since high school!? Weren't you engaged!? Weren't you supposed to become my brother-in-law!?"
"Takahiro-kun…!"
"Give them back! Give back those five years you stole from her… those five years you completely ruined, Kitahara!"
"S-Sto… Stop it, Takahiro! Please stop it already… Uu-uhn… Dear, please!"
"And… where is Haruki-kun now?"
"…! Ugh… uuh…"
"Where is Haruki-kun!?"
"He just left. Less than five minutes ago."
"Stop right there, Setsuna!"
"It's too late. I won't allow you to go outside right now."
"You must be joking! After all the terrible things you guys did to Haruki-kun! Ganging up on him and causing him so much pain!"
"Setsuna…"
"I hate you… I hate you all, I loathe you!"
"Nee-chan…"
"Everyone tries to go after Haruki-kun, everyone tries to push him away from me. I hate you all!"
"…Ouch."
My burning hot cheeks are grazed by the cold wind, and the pain I was numb to finally makes itself known.
I still have tunnel vision.
The blood from the cut in my mouth mixes with the blood from my nose, and a horrible taste envelops my tongue.
…Yet I was oblivious to the pain from all these wounds up until a short while ago.
"Stop it, Takahiro! Did you not hear me when I told you to stop!?"
"I won't allow you to act violently toward someone else. He's… someone who has nothing to do with our family."
"Kitahara-kun… I'm sorry for my son's horrible behavior. Please forgive us."
"If you have to go to the hospital because of this, I'll take responsibility for all the expenses needed. I'm truly sorry."
"And, please do me this favor. I'm aware that it's rude considering I was the one who called you here, but…"
"Don't come here ever again."
"…I'm sorry."
Her father's words, her mother's crying.
And her brother's relentless fists…
Those actions that reinforce the fact that they love their family. The realization of that hurts…
Because it felt like my heart was going to be torn in two.
"Good… I made it in time."
And for a second time, my physical pain is chased away by sheer emotional pain.
"Setsuna… Why?"
"There is a short-cut around here, one only the residents here know about. A narrow back alley."
Even though she was completely out of breath, Setsuna continued to explain.
Yet her explanation wasn't the reason she chased me, only the reason she caught up with me.
"This will feel a bit cold, but try to bear it."
Setsuna took out a handkerchief and wettened it by a nearby water fountain. Just like she said, even my burning cheeks felt like they were going to freeze over.
Yet I couldn't feel sorry for myself, because I felt at the same time the coldness in Setsuna's hands as she gripped the handkerchief.
"I'm sorry, Takahiro really did something stupid…"
"There's no reason for you to apologize, Setsuna, and Takahiro-kun isn't in the wrong either."
"No, he is in the wrong… hurting you like this. Even though they know you're the most important person to me… They're all so cruel."
"Setsuna."
The cruel one here is me. Yet even now, Setsuna is still defending me.
Her true feelings, her escape from reality, and her numerous misunderstandings blended together, and her feelings for me have become even stronger than before.
Almost like me, she's making enemies of everyone around her.
"This might sting a bit, try to bear it one more time, okay?"
"You really don't have to…"
"Hey, don't move. You're not a little kid, so you can bear it."
Setsuna didn't allow me to speak about what happened.
When she appeared in front of me, she was holding a first aid box in both hands. A big box with every possible necessity.
The fact that I came over, that I spoke to her parents, and that I got myself injured.
Overwhelmed with so many truths that disturbed her heart, Setsuna threw all her thoughts away and instead chose to come running with this heavy box.
"Ah, sorry!"
Her rash behavior, her adorableness… and the lovable way she's harboring these assumptions as she heals the wounds on my cheeks.
And with them, I can feel a bit of pain, coldness, and a never-ending warmth.
"Okay… that should do it. Good job."
After finally applying some gauze around my mouth and sticking it in place with tape, Setsuna puts the materials back into the first aid box.
All with a composed expression. All while we're in an atmosphere that's no different to how things used to be.
It's almost as if nothing had happened. Almost as if the two of us were back to our old selves.
"Is it a little hard for you to speak? Could you try saying something?"
"Stop… taking my side already."
"…I didn't ask you to talk about that. A single word would have been enough. I just wanted to make sure the tape wouldn't peel off."
Yet all that was a front that could be broken apart with a single word.
"Don't reach out to those in the wrong. You've hurt yourself enough…"
"I'm the one who gets to decide that. It's not something you get a say in, Haruki-kun…"
Yet, that stubbornness…
The first time I realized that Setsuna would never admit any fault in me was back then.
"The three of us can be together…"
"I just wanted the three of us to stay together forever. I didn't want to be left out by those I cared about."
"No, I want the three of us to be together. So nothing's actually over between us…"
"Let's go, Haruki-kun. The three of us aren't finished yet."
Right now, we're sharing the memories about the same place, and the same time.
But that is not a coincidence.
Because the situation back then and right now are far too similar to each other.
"That's right… because that's precisely what I've always wanted since the beginning."
"Setsuna…"
"Let's go back to when it was just Kazusa, you and me. Let's go back to that day… before the school festival."
Five years have passed… yet Setsuna is still the same.
"Kazusa went away because of me, so I thought I could never see it come to fruition."
She decides that everything is her own fault, and comes up with these contrived reasons to show why I'm faultless.
"That's why I thought I could replace it with a different kind of happiness with just the two of us. I believed we could live together…"
Always putting herself in the worst position.
"But, but… if that's not possible…"
"No, that's not it! I'm not sad that it's not possible, I don't feel regret."
However…
"Because all we have to do is… wrap ourselves in a happiness that's even greater than what we had five years ago."
However, Setsuna…
"So please, Haruki-kun. Let me join you two… don't leave me out of your company…!"
This time alone…
"You can't…"
"Why…?"
Because I love Setsuna too much to keep the balance even between the three of us.
"No one would accept that kind of relationship."
"No one has to accept us. As long as the three of us are happy, I don't need anything else…"
Even so, if I were to force myself to accept the three of us being together, I won't be able to return to just the two of us ever again.
…And that goes for both Kazusa and Setsuna.
"You can't… Out of all people, you shouldn't be saying that, Setsuna."

I'd only end up making the two people I care about more than anyone else in the world completely miserable, chaining them to myself in a limbo where I'm closely tied to the both of them, yet also indecisive at the same time.
"I'll say it, let me say it… After all, I love both you and Kazusa, and this is finally our chance for us three to get back together."
"I'm… going to Vienna, so we can't be together anymore."
So I'll have to make the choice, the future without Setsuna.
…Even if it means I have to use different means… I cannot involve Setsuna in a future without light at the end of the tunnel.
"You're going with Kazusa…"
"Yes."
Setsuna slowly puts her fingers on my shoulder.
If she embraced me, or kissed me, I wouldn't have the strength to push her away.
She doesn't get any closer than that; even now, she's trying her best to not cause me more trouble.
Or rather…
"Then, I'm going with. I'm going to Vienna with you!"
"Setsuna…"
She's giving me up to Kazusa.
"From now on, I'll be with you, Haruki-kun… and Kazusa too. It's okay, I promise I won't be a burden to you."
Without questioning how unreasonable Kazusa and I are being, she brings back all the guilt she was supposed to have thrown away two years ago.
"You can't."
"Why!?"
If everything is her responsibility, then everything will be solved if she merely changes herself.
Those are the nightmarish delusions she is trying to convince herself of.
"Because you have a family, you have Io, and Yanagihara. You have so many others you have bonds with."
"I don't need any of them!"
Even as I'm making a choice that will bring happiness to no one, she's denying it with a choice with an even more miserable outcome.
"Family, friends, my job… As long as I have you two, I don't need any of it…"
"Of course you do! There's just no way you'd be able to endure such a thing!"
If she makes such a depraved decision, she'll inevitably get hurt.
After all, Setsuna just isn't the kind of person who can live without interacting with others around her.
She's the kind of person who asks for help and helps others. The kind who supports others in their time of need, and lets others help her with her own weaknesses.
…Setsuna is, or rather, most people are like that…
Setsuna is the kind of person who can firmly plant her roots in this world… just like a normal person does.
That's why if she becomes uprooted from the earth… she'll be separated from the world and wither away.
Moreover…
"It's not just about you, it's about Kazusa too…"
"I'll fix all my shortcomings. I'll do my best without pushing it too hard. I'll have a proper talk with Kazusa. So please, please… please…!"
"You can't… because even if you try your hardest, Kazusa can't."
"Unh… ah… I won't steal you anymore… I won't take you away from Kazusa anymore…!"
No, that's not it, Setsuna…
Kazusa still loves you too. She has always loved you.
But… this is different. The "three of us" that you're thinking of is not the same as the one Kazusa is thinking of.
What you want is a "three of us" that exists in a broader world.
A group surrounded by warmth, and kindness… and sometimes sternness from loved ones. A vast, and proper way of life.
But that's not what Kazusa sees…
No matter how much she tried to broaden her horizons throughout these five years, it never worked out. The only places where she belonged was with Youko-san and within her memories.
The piano introduced Kazusa to a broader world, but it couldn't provide her with that world. …It's because she rejected it.
If Setsuna is a tree that plants roots, then Kazusa is a tumbleweed. It's just not possible for her to extend her roots and live firmly.
She must find water to sustain herself little by little as she goes, separated both from the ground and the world.
"It's only me. The only one she needs is me."
"Aaaaaah…!"
It's not a matter of whether I love her or not.
As someone who has lived in contact with the broad horizons of the world up until now, and as someone who can live without that world, I alone can be the water she needs. …That's all there is to it.
"Setsuna… you should just forget about me."
But there is no way Setsuna would understand even if I did tell her.
"And I'll forget about you too."
So all I can tell her are these words of farewell.
"Aaaaaaah!"
"I'm going with Kazusa… I'm going together with Kazusa."
"Uaaaaaaaaaaaah… Noooooooooooooo…"
I'm going with Kazusa.
There is no longer anyone but us two. I'll start living in a world for Kazusa alone.
If it means protecting Kazusa, I might be the only one coming into contact with the world.
But I won't bring that world with me back to Kazusa.
I won't waver anymore.
No one can enter the world for Kazusa and me.
"Ah…"
"What are you doing here? What time do you think it is?"
I don't remember if it was me or Setsuna who left first.
I don't even remember which road I used to return here.
Yet, before I knew it, I was in front of my apartment.
And late in the night, well after midnight, someone was waiting for me in the freezing entranceway.
"Your face…"
"Answer my question first. Take turns."
It was Kazusa who was waiting for me outside the door, breathing warm air into her world-famous hands…
"I was waiting in the apartment, but you wouldn't come home. And when I called you, you weren't answering."
"Ah… I turned it off, sorry."
"So I went outside for a bit to see if I could pick you up at the station, but then I was worried I might have missed you on the way, so I rushed back."
"When I saw you still weren't back, I decided to sulk in bed but I couldn't fall asleep, so I went back to waiting."
"…And then?"
"Then… that cycle repeated itself about five times."
"If you have that much free time on your hands, then just go to sleep. Your concert is only a week away."
What an idiot… How counterproductive can she be?
"Yeah, but we were taking turns. What happened to your face, Haruki…?"
"Oh, right! You want a drink of this? I bought it in the convenience store just earlier."
"…Avoiding the question, are we?"
"I don't know what you're talking about…"
"Tell me, what happened? You're injured, and you're carrying a bottle of wine."
"I considered drinking it on the way home, but…"
"But?"
"I remembered I hadn't fed you yet."
"…What time do you think it is?"
But that part of her dragged me out a little from the pit of despair.
"You went out and got yourself hurt again without telling me, didn't you? And not just your face, but your heart too."
"…I don't know what you're talking about."
…She shouldn't do this. Providing relief to the person who deserves nothing but condemnation.
"Don't go and make things harder for yourself without telling me. You don't belong to yourself anymore."
"You mean to say that 'my body' doesn't belong to 'only' myself anymore. Don't neglect the important parts."
"It's the same thing. You're mine now."
"Kazusa…"
I'm sure Setsuna's breaking into tears right now. And I've caused the smiles of the Ogiso family to disappear.
Everything is my fault, yet I'm the one being comforted.
"Like always, you make things harder for everyone. Not just for other people, because you don't even hold back against yourself. That makes you the biggest bully there is."
"If you think I'm hurt, shouldn't you console me with a bit more kindness?"
But because you keep clinging on to me, I can't help finding solace in you.
"Oh? What course would you like?"
"Well… the one where you hug me softly without saying a word."
I can't help trying to obtain what I'm not allowed to desire.
"…If you let me, I won't go easy on you."
"Ah…"
I'll end up showing cracks in my resolve.
"I'll hug you with all my heart. I'll kiss you with such fervor that I won't be able to stop until we've gone all the way, you know."
"…That's not what gentle consoling means."
"I'll make you forget about everything, you know?"
"…That's what guys are supposed to say."
"The rest is up to you."
"Until you give me the go-ahead… I'll sit obediently and wag my tail for you. I'll keep waiting while anxiously thinking about when you'll come for me."
I think I heard her purr for a second.
Perhaps she was sensitive to that crack in my resolve, so that at the first sight of it, a switch went off inside of her.
Her lust for me, her desire to save me.
Those two intense desires that exist within Kazusa.
"Kazusa… I…"
"…Just kidding. Like you'd have the guts to do that."
"Eh?"
Yet Kazusa represses those feelings.
"You have no guts, but you're strong. You don't have the slightest need for my kindness."
"That's not…"
"Well, I'll be waiting. If you ever feel like you want me, just say the word. I'll never reject you again."
But as I thought, she's showing such restraint for my sake. Her way of showing that she prioritizes my feelings over anything else.
No matter what Kazusa does, it's always about me, me, me…
There may no longer be a person by the name of Touma Kazusa who doesn't live under my shadow.
"Anyway, come in. Not like it's my apartment or anything, though."
Then I'll…
"…! Haruki…?"
I'll…
"…Are you sure?"
For some reason, she tried to make sure.
The moment we entered the apartment, I hugged her from behind so tightly she couldn't move, yet she was the one who asked if it's okay.
"Will you be able to hold back? Will you be able to forgive yourself?"
To most people, her question wouldn't make any sense.
Because it looks like I'm about to take her by force, yet her only worry is for me.
"Kazusa…"
That innocence once again permeates my brain, and little by little, the pain in my heart goes numb.
"…If you're going to hug me, I'd prefer if you'd take off your boots first. We won't be able to make it to the bed like this."
I'm not allowed to feel this kind of solace, yet…
Kazusa's body is so soft and warm. It smells so good.
"So… let me go, for ten seconds only."
"Kazusa… Kazusa…!"
"Haruki…"
I could push her down with all my force and lean my body over her. I could experience the sensation of her body.
I could take off her jacket almost as if tearing it off, and I could force my hands through the opening to grope her soft, round breasts.
"I'm so happy."
I could put my other hand down her skirt and feel around her thighs, her butt, and her most important place. I could put my finger inside every cavity she has and press it in.
"I'm… finally of some use to you."
But even then, Kazusa would continue to withdraw her strength, and close her eyes with a warm sigh. She'd still try to accept me with her entire being.
"I can save you… even if for a little bit."
"Ah, ah…!"
Even knowing how short lived the moment will be…
Kazusa would still see serving as nothing more than a painkiller to me as something happy.
"…I'm sorry."
"…Well, in a sense I knew this would happen."
And in the end…
I apologized, not for taking her by force, but for not doing so.
"I know it would bring me relief to make love to you. I know I would feel overwhelmed with happiness, but…"
I made a vow.
I swore that I wouldn't lust after Kazusa while we were still in Japan. That we wouldn't cultivate our love until everything here is settled.
No matter how pointless it is in the end. Even if it brings absolutely no one any happiness…
If I break this vow, I can't be certain I won't break further, more important vows in the future. I'll continue living as dishonestly as I always have.
"Haruki… you really are stupid. You're obstinate, beyond stubborn, and you always argue about every little thing… You're completely beyond saving."
"I'm sorry, Kazusa… Every time I lose my way, call me out on it."
"It's fine. I'm used to your blue-balling at this point. And besides…"
"Besides?"
"It's because you're like this that there's a purpose in me hugging you like this."
"Kazusa…"
Despite everything wrong with me, Kazusa accepts me unconditionally.
"Hey, Haruki… I love you."
"I love you too."
We don't seek to improve each other, to correct each other's faults.
Without changing, without improving, we affirm and accept each other.
"Then at least cry in my arms. Let me be of some use."
"Okay…"
There is no future. We don't need it.
As long as this moment can last forever, everything will be fine.
"Hey, Kazusa…"
"Hm?"
"Let's be… happy together, the two of us."
"Okay…"
Then we will be able to live in happiness forever.
All while trampling on everyone else important to us…
No, it's precisely because we've had to trample on them that we alone have to find our happiness.
The amount of suffering we've caused to so many people would have been for nothing otherwise.
"Leave it to me, Haruki. This time… I'll be the one protecting you."
For a while, I listened in drowsiness to Kazusa's whispers.
At that moment, I couldn't tell if I was crying or not.
